title: Drawings and Paintings
text:
Agrius convolvuli (3D paper model) - 30/10/2025
Brown ink, watercolour and PVA glue (Vinavil) on paper.
I was commissioned to design and make a life-size 3D model of the moth Agrius convolvuli as a graduation gift. I also crocheted the light-green plant in the mini-environment.


Pedes Silentio Pandit - 21/08/2025
Blue ink and water on A4 paper.
The title is Latin and translates as “It [the spider] silently stretches its legs”.



 
Space (and preliminary sketch, below) - 11/9/2024
Black ink on paper, \(20 \times 20 cm\).


In Front of the Wall - 22/8/2024
Green ink and water on A4 paper.


Allegory of Research (2) - 9/2023
Brown ink and white paint (+ watercolour for the background) on A4 paper.


Drosera capensis - 8/2023
Oil on canvas board, \(25 \times 25 cm\).
The octagonal frame is made of plywood and painted in watercolour.

 
Allegory of Theoretical and Experimental Physics (and preliminary sketch, below) - 19/3/2023
Black ink with mapping dip pen, highlighter ink, watercolor and water-soluble graphite pencils on A5 paper.
The cat (Lisca) on the right is the smallest Lisca I have ever drawn.


Exercise: Landscape - ??/1/2023
Black ink and watercolour on A5 paper.




Dragon Self-Portrait - 29/7/2022
Black ink and charcoal on A4 dark-yellow paper.


Cloudy Cat, or Ginger’s Portrait - 4/7/2022
Watercolour (dip pen and brush) on A4 paper.
Ginger is the cat of my cousine.


Lisca’s Portrait - 1/6/2022
Black ink and water-soluble graphite pencils on A5 paper.

 
Werewolf Game Cards - ??/2022
Black ink and pencil on A4 paper.
This is my own variation on the Werewolf game:
Werewolf   clairvoyant   basilisk   necromancer
guard   spy   suspicious character   hired assassin
plague-spreader   apprentice werewolf   wizard   hyena
pack leader   [failed trial]   [failed trial]   wolf-tamer
doctor   [failed trial]   Fortune   stryx
actor/chameleon   [empty slot]   [empty slot]   [empty slot]


Grotesque Five-Headed Animal - ??/2022
Blacl ink and water-soluble pencils on A5 paper.


Exercise: 1€ - 23/2/2022
Pencil and charcoal, \(7.5 \times 5.5 cm\).


Experimental Setup for Conductivity Measure - 20/11/2021
Black and blue ink on A5 paper.
Despite I already was a convinced theoretical physicist and I suffered laboratory activity, I was at least able to draw the experimental setup for the lab report, since we had not a sufficiently clear photo…

Black ink, charcoal and water-soluble graphite pencils on A4 paper.

title: Comic Strips
text:
Unfortunately, I used to write my comic strips in Italian when I was at university. However, here I add the English translation below each cartoon.



“My lord, this young rat is the architect in charge of the new temple for the cat-goddess Bastet.”
“It looks promising! …but what magnificence does that rectangle on the map represent? A pond of snakes? A pool of milk? An immense golden altar?”
“It’s a gigantic litter tray for the goddess!”


“The advantage of abstract paintings is that they don’t have a right side up, so you can’t accidentally hang them upside down!”


“I wonder how the new ‘funds for a greener city’ will be employed…”
[On the right, a house painter is painting the walls of a building green]


“It’s so hot! Why do we wear all these clothes? We’re rats: we have fur, after all!”
“We must stand! Otherwise, what excuse would we have to continue going shopping?”


“To protect your savings, it is not a good idea to invest them in diamonds. Indeed, they will almost all have decayed into graphite in a few million years!”


“With my white canvas, I represent the vacuity of life and everything… moreover, I save the money I would have spent on paint.”




“Wait! Look! That’s my latest invention!”


“Well, be rational…!”




“Henceforth, thanks to my invention, uncapping water bottles will no longer be a problem!”
[The other scientist, now transformed into a gigantic monster, easily uncaps a water bottle]
“Yes! It’s extremely easy now!”


[Sign on the wall:   “Classroom 1-5 \(\leftarrow\)   Classroom 7-11 \(\rightarrow\)   Classroom 6 \(\uparrow\)”
Classroom 6 is visible at the end of the corridor, behind the two students]
“No: Classroom 6 isn’t even behind that grid…!




Fossiguf:   “Jril is usually painting at this time… I’m going to visit her: she hasn’t spoken to me about her paintings for a few days, and that’s unusual…”
Jril:   “STOP! I’m fed up!”   [Jril throws away a painting]   “I can’t stand painting white flowers, black flowers, black and white flowers anymore… ARGH! I give up!”
Fossiguf:   “If that’s the problem, Jril, why don’t you try painting red, yellow or even blue flowers? What’s stopping you?”
Jril:   “…the simple fact that we’re in a black-and-white comic strip, Fossiguf: here, colours don’t exist.”


Unfortunately, this pun has no English equivalent. In Italian a pet is an “animale domestico” (= domestic animal) while a household appliance is an “elettrodomestico” (= electro-domestic). If I were to translate literally to awkwardly preserve the pun:
Fossiguf:   “Your Majesty, here is my latest invention: the electro-domestic! All the affection of a domestic animal is guaranteed, but it doesn’t eat, doesn’t drink, and is absolutely clean!”
“M-E-O-W”


Fossiguf:   “So, Gilva, have you done the homework I gave you?”
…hm… well… Let us read your philosophical reflection…
But… this… is an empty page!
Congratulations, Gilva! You’re a true philosopher now! The way you have condensed so many profound reflections into a single statement is extraordinary!


Fossiguf:   “Admire, Jril, my latest invention!”
Jril:   “It’s really impressive! What does it do?”
Fossiguf:   “Well, I don’t know yet, but I have no doubt that it is extremely useful.”
